blocks.text: The 2026 MAMA Awards kick off Friday, Nov. 20, at Kyocera Dome Osaka, bringing together veteran K-pop acts, rising rookies and some of the year’s biggest releases for two days of awards and one-off performances. This year’s ceremony, held under the theme “A Music Interstellar,” is built around the idea of connecting different generations, genres and forms of art, according to producer CJ ENM. The event will be divided into two chapters, with Friday’s event focusing on artist categories and Saturday’s event centered on performances and works.
